description_en: Provides an asynchronous interface for interacting with DAS Agent powered by large language model capabilities
description_zh: DAS大模型能力异步逻辑接口
name: Chat

parameters.help_en: The session ID in UUID string format. If not specified, a new session is created by default. To maintain context across conversations, use the same session ID
parameters.help_zh: 可选，会话 ID，格式为 UUID 字符串。如未指定默认创建新的会话。上下文对话需保持同一个会话 ID
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The Agent ID used for the service. You can specify an Agent generated after enabling DAS Agent or an Agent that you manually created. If not specified, the default Agent is used
parameters.help_zh: 可选，用于服务的 Agent ID。可指定为开启 DAS Agent 后生成的Agent 或主动创建的 Agent。如未指定则使用默认 Agent 进行服务
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output summary information
parameters.name: summary
